arguments.message:
Yes – you can set up a scheduled export that automatically writes a new file to your cloud storage on a weekly basis.

1. In the app go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Pick the data you want to export and set the recurrence to **weekly**.
3. Connect your cloud‑storage provider (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.) via the OAuth link – this only needs to be done once per destination.
4. Save the schedule.

Each run will create a new file in the connected destination, and the scheduled‑exports screen will show the history of runs and whether they succeeded. This method bypasses the 10 000‑row browser cap and eliminates the need for manual downloads.
